infoPlist.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: RNDVU uses Bluetooth to connect to your mesh device and communicate with your crew.
infoPlist.NSBluetoothPeripheralUsageDescription: RNDVU uses Bluetooth to connect to your mesh device.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: RNDVU uses your location to share your position with your crew on the festival map.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: RNDVU uses your location in the background to keep your crew updated on your position.
infoPlist.NSNearbyInteractionUsageDescription: RNDVU uses Ultra Wideband to point you to a crew member when you're close, like Find My.
infoPlist.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: RNDVU connects directly to a nearby crew member's phone, without the internet, to start precise finding.

plugins.bluetoothAlwaysPermission: RNDVU uses Bluetooth to connect to your mesh device.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: RNDVU uses your location to share with your crew.

plugins.cameraPermission: RNDVU uses the camera to scan your crew's invite QR code, and to point you to a crew member up close.
